item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','ignored'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':{'n':1}},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'n':1},'hash':'x','kind':'file'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'same','size':1},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'same','size':2},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}},},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']}),({'declared':['new','gone'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'new':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone','new']})]\\nfor request,policy,expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy)); actual=evaluate(request,policy); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); assert request==before[0] and policy==before[1]\\ndata=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in data]; print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True)); assert actual==[{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}]\\nprint('boundary checks passed')\"]}}]}"}
